Subject: Azure private offer: regional burst request and term alignment

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick summary and ask from our side: Nimbus is planning a short-term surge in inference volume tied to a new feature launch. We expect peak throughput for ~3 months for our US-west workloads (approx +220% baseline token volume).

Our questions/asks:
- Can Redwood provision a regional burst on Azure (westus2) via a private offer / marketplace route so we have reserved capacity?
- We'd like to shorten the commitment window to 9 months (instead of 12) to align with our fiscal project runway — will that be acceptable from the marketplace vendor process?
- What paperwork do you need from procurement to start a private offer (PO, forecast, legal contact)?

I've attached a usage forecast (nimbus-usage-forecast.xlsx) and a short note on expected ramp dates. If we can target sign by end of month (Jun 30) we can meet our internal launch schedule.

CC'ing Anna (procurement) who will prepare the PO once we confirm the exact offer path. Also happy to loop in the Azure marketplace rep if a co-signed private offer is required.

Thanks,
Suresh

Director, Platform Ops
NimbusAI

Hi Suresh — great to sync earlier. Short answers first: yes, we can run a regional private offer on Azure for a westus2 burst; and a 9-month commitment is doable but will need Partner Ops approval and a slight pricing adjustment for the shortened term.

Proposed immediate next steps (I can own coordination):
1) Kimberley and Ben will confirm the acceptance playbook items and any SLA exceptions for a burst (see attached redwood-acceptance-playbook.pdf).
2) Anna: please prepare the formal PO once we confirm the offer template and dollar values. We typically need a PDF-signed PO referencing the private offer ID.
3) I'll open a private-offer request with Azure marketplace and loop in their marketplace sales contact; we'll need Partner Ops clearance for term change.

Target timeline:
- Jun 13: Redwood to propose offer template and provisional pricing
- Jun 16: Nimbus provides final PO and any KMS/encryption notes
- Jun 18–20: Partner Ops & Azure review
- Jun 24–30: DocuSign and execution (aiming for Jun 30 sign)

I've attached the Acceptance Playbook for our standard private-offer on-boarding path. If you can confirm the forecast rows that map to reserved capacity tiers by EOD Jun 13 that will speed approvals.

Thanks — I put Kyle (not on this thread) on standby to help with capacity routing if the ramp looks steeper.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Hi team,

Looping in procurement and Azure. A couple of procurement / Ops items from our side for a private offer with a shortened term:
- Partner Ops requires a short justification memo when the term is <12 months; we use this to validate risk and pricing cadence. Stephanie, I can draft that memo once Suresh confirms the forecast.
- PO specifics: we need a signed PDF PO that includes (1) Private Offer ID (when provided), (2) purchase amounts per month, (3) billing contact, and (4) tax/VAT info.
- DocuSign flow: Azure Marketplace typically routes through Partner Center -> DocuSign; Azure rep (cc'ed) can confirm expected turnaround.

Action items for Nimbus:
- Send final PO PDF to kimberly_park@redwood.com and anna@nimbusai.com by Jun 16 (please include billing address and preferred signer).
- Confirm whether you need KMS/HSM key integration — that may add ~3 business days to acceptance.

Attached is an example PO we accept (nimbus-azure-po.pdf) with the minimal fields filled for reference.

Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Procurement
Redwood Inference
